message: 衝突、そして……

name: Helena
message: 「Excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Miss Helena. What's the matter?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, well... I was wondering if Melilot might be bothering you here」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope. She hasn't come by」

name: Synn
message: 「That's unusual. You normally seem to know everything about Miss Melilot」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes... For her to just vanish somewhere without consulting me...」

name: Helena
message: 「She'd been cooped up in the library for a while, so what could have happened... I have... a bad feeling about this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come to think of it, Mr. Azel. Didn't you say you had business with the librarian?」

name: Azel
message: 「O-Oh, right... I thought I might be of some help regarding Bylous, but...」

name: Helena
message: 「Bylous... Now that you mention it, Melilot was muttering that name over and over like a prayer...」

name: Helena
message: 「...!! Hey, Azel!! Could Bylous and Melilot actually know each other!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't know... However, the odds that the two of them have crossed paths are high」

name: Helena
message: 「If that happens... Melilot will attack him!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Surely she wouldn't be that foolish. Bylous's power is beyond anything ordinary」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why she was making thorough preparations!! Oh, that girl, honestly! Hiding something this important...」

name: Synn
message: 「Miss Helena, what's wrong! Please calm down」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot... That girl intended to fight Bylous」

name: Azel
message: 「Absurd...!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte! We're searching for Melilot... right now!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-Yes, sir!」
Countless traps laid out in every direction.
At first, it seemed as though even Bylous was being toyed with.
Yet petty tricks are useless against one hailed as the strongest.

name: Bylous
message: 「Witch. You certainly gave me quite the hard time」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ngh... ugh...」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, you could never stand in for the Demon Lord with a style of fighting that refuses to face an opponent head-on」

name: Melilot
message: 「N-not yet... My stratagem is... u-ugh...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Boring...」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Such terrible wounds...! At this rate...

name: Azel
message: 「Helena! Take Melilot and go!」

name: Helena
message: 「...Understood」
In truth, she probably wanted to land at least one punch on Bylous's face, yet she must have sensed in an instant that he was no opponent she could do that to.
Holding Melilot in her arms, Helena hurried away.

name: Lolotte
message: 「To do something so awful to Melilot...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I had placed a sliver of hope in it, yet... it never turned into a fight to the death」

name: Azel
message: 「What point is there in piling up any more disappointment」

name: Bylous
message: 「Fighting needs no point. Fighting itself is the point」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you so obsessed with fighting, Bylous」

name: Azel
message: 「A berserker who revels in clashing with the strong... What a worthless ideology」

name: Bylous
message: 「That provocation... means I may interpret it favorably, does it not?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please step back, Azel. With everyone from the Crusaders here, surely--」

name: Azel
message: 「Your legs are trembling... You intend to stand against the power that struck down Melilot. It is only natural...」

name: Azel
message: 「And even so, you still mean to put yourself on the line to protect me...」

name: Azel
message: 「Forgive me. I ask that you leave this to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel, what on earth...」

name: Azel
message: 「Even without relying solely on Re-Crea... my power--」
Seeing Azel clad in a divine aura, Bylous nodded in satisfaction.

name: Azel
message: 「Crusaders! Leave this place at once. I will be Bylous's opponent!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You mustn't. Trying to shoulder this all alone is--」

name: Azel
message: 「No!! You will only get in my way!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh... b-but... but...!」
Words meant to push us away, sounding almost cold.
Yet, this was an opponent she couldn't defeat if her focus was divided by having to protect us.
Perhaps those were the best possible words, born precisely because Azel cared for others.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, I can't just leave you all alone, Azel-san!」
Despite everything, Lolotte tried desperately to stand her ground.
Looking at Lolotte like that, Azel smiled strangely.

name: Azel
message: 「I believe in all of you. So, believe in me as well.」
Azel gently approached the pressing Lolotte and lightly tapped the nape of her neck.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, Azel-sa, n...」

name: Azel
message: 「I no longer think of myself as being alone... so believe in me and wait」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, ugh... uh」
And then she entrusted the unconscious Lolotte's body to me.

name: Azel
message: 「Take care of Lolotte.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... If only I became the Demon Lord, none of this would...」

name: Azel
message: 「For the Demon Lord's power to awaken would mean Re-Crea has already progressed beyond the point of no return.」

name: Azel
message: 「In that case, is it not better that it remains dormant? So, do not trouble yourself over it. Until we meet again.」
Azel gave a slight bow with a smile brighter than ever before.
And then--

name: Azel
message: 「Let us go, Bylous.」
Just like that, the two of them vanished into the light.

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-san... she really went.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I want to believe her... I really do. But what if this ends up being goodbye...」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san! Stop saying such ominous things!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, you...?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I can't... I'm still a guy, after all!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Lolotte said so. Azel, you're not... alone anymore!」
I leave Lolotte with everyone else and chase after the two of them.
Even if the Demon Lord's power doesn't awaken, we still have our own strength to support Azel!
